timing: BEFORE any original source outcome values or genotype rows read; only original CSV header, original study metadata, and source-free fixture reviewed
issue: Original prereg uniformly required >=10 distinct mutational sites per assay. Wu 2016 Protein G experiment is explicitly a 4-site combinatorial mutational landscape, so 10-site gate would reject valid original data for a known-design reason, regardless of outcomes.
correction: Olson 2014 >=10 distinct source FIT mutational sites; Wu 2016 >=4 (and <=4 not required). Require >=20 distinct FIT mutation site-state features and >=350/75/75 FIT/VALID/DEV measured multi-mutants in BOTH assays unchanged.
unchanged: whole genotype SHA256 hash salt and thresholds
independence: This is an ex-ante fixed study design correction, not a response to numeric outcome or split counts. If data still fails the amended gate, stop and mark INVALID.
